name: voidmob
description: Receive SMS verification codes for your own accounts on real US non-VoIP numbers, keep a dedicated number, buy eSIM data for travel, and use 4G/5G mobile IPs by country for geo testing. Paid from a prepaid VoidMob balance. Every purchase needs the price Claude showed you.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your vmk_live_... key from https://dashboard.voidmob.com/developers/api-keys. It can spend your prepaid balance. Leave empty with sandbox mode on.

sandbox.title: Sandbox mode
sandbox.description: Use offline mock data with a $500 play balance. No key needed and nothing is charged.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that spends money or changes anything. Claude can still search prices and read your orders.

max_order_cents.title: Max per order (US cents)
max_order_cents.description: Refuse any single purchase above this many whole US cents (2500 = $25.00). Leave empty for no limit.

budget_cents.title: Session budget (US cents)
budget_cents.description: Stop buying once this many whole US cents were spent since the server started (5000 = $50.00). Also keeps auto-renew off. Leave empty for no budget.
